<<prodname>> and <<WebexCC>>  integration currently supports five channels - SMS, Email, Facebook Messenger, and Live Chat. Here are the details of how you can configure the channel assets for each of these channels within <<prodname>>.

| Channel                     | Documentation                                                                                |
| :-------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SMS                         | [SMS Asset Creation](doc:wxcc-sms-assset-creation)                                           |
| Email                       | [Email Asset Creation](doc:wxcc-email-asset-creation)                                        |
| Facebook Messenger          | [Facebook Messenger Asset Creation](doc:wxcc-fbm-asset-creation)                             |
| Live Chat                   | [LiveChat Asset Creation](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/wxcc-livechat-asset-creation)      |
| WhatsApp                    | [WhatsApp Asset Creation](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/wxcc-whatsapp-asset-creation)      |
| Apple Messages for Business | [Apple Messages for Business](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/apple-messages-for-business-1) |
